node.name: Polycarbonate, at plant, disaggregated
node.comment: drafted from the dataset's own ecoSpold metadata

inputs.name: Bisphenol A, powder, at plant
inputs.note: 100 %-yield floor; the real amount can only be higher.

derivation.quote: production by interfacial polycondesation out of phosgene and bisphenol A
derivation.equation: C15H16O2 (bisphenol A, 228.291) + COCl2 (phosgene, 98.910) -> -[C16H14O3]- (carbonate repeat unit, 254.285) + 2 HCl (72.916)
derivation.mapping_reason: The only candidate that is bisphenol A; the others are different powders.

inputs.name: Phosgene, liquid, at plant
inputs.note: 100 %-yield floor; the real amount can only be higher.

derivation.quote: production by interfacial polycondesation out of phosgene and bisphenol A
derivation.equation: C15H16O2 (bisphenol A, 228.291) + COCl2 (phosgene, 98.910) -> -[C16H14O3]- (carbonate repeat unit, 254.285) + 2 HCl (72.916)
derivation.mapping_reason: The only phosgene candidate; the rest are other liquids.

inputs.name: Sodium hydroxide, 50% in H2O, production mix, at plant
inputs.note: An interfacial polycondensation runs the bisphenol as its sodium salt in an aqueous phase; the 2 HCl per repeat unit are neutralised by caustic soda.

derivation.calculation: 2 x 39.997 / 254.285 = 0.31459 kg NaOH (100 %) per kg of polycarbonate
derivation.mapping_reason: The production mix is the generic purchased caustic soda; the cell-specific datasets are single routes.
